assessment: Alpha.854: OpenGenesisLINK upstream main 8b3d80e, nine new commits including opt-in FastRez #281 with WearablesRequestDelayMs=1000 and near-first 64m object queue; unchanged LLUDP Low158/Low382 formats. Fixed actual pre-circuit-readiness race: genuine self AvatarAppearance and AgentWearablesUpdate could be dispatched from circuit thread before UI published region.connected, so Low158 was discarded and Low382 readback rejected indefinitely (only initial request). WorldModel now stages one strict validated self Low158 and Low382 bound to agent/session/region generation; latest meaningful COF and modulo serial guards prevent early replay. Main thread consumes each once only after authenticated circuit/region ready and updates existing F3 accepted counters; region/session/reset invalidates stage. Native WorldModel tests wired Mint and Pi5 ARM64 plus Python production integration and full local Mint x64 GUI release gate. Previous exact SHA Pi5 Alpha844 712dbe9 Run 39840873191 success. Authenticated NexVerse AvatarAppearance/COF/Outfit/Skin actual GPU and simulator-confirmed WASD/yaw E2E still open. No deployment.
